data.title: Can Benjamin Netanyahu legally attack Iran while Gadi Eisenkot works to form a government? | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: As Eisenkot works to form a government, Netanyahu retains the power to act against Iran. But Israeli law raises questions about launching a new war under a caretaker government.
